expectations.text: Lays out a quarterly rhythm: Q1 scoping refresh/RCM updates, Q2 walkthroughs + interim testing, Q3 second testing wave + deficiency triage while remediation windows remain, Q4 roll-forward/update testing, remediation validation, aggregation analysis, management's 404(a) conclusion
expectations.evidence: Q1 "Refresh the scoping memo... Update RCMs"; Q2 "TOD walkthroughs... Interim TOE wave 1... Deficiency triage"; Q3 "Interim TOE wave 2... last real remediation window"; Q4 "Roll-forward... Remediation validation... Final aggregation analysis... Management's 404(a) conclusion"

expectations.text: Places user access reviews quarterly and terminations/privileged-access checks as continuous — the classic late-surprise sources
expectations.evidence: UAR cycles 1-4 each quarter; "termination deprovisioning and privileged access — review monthly at minimum"; "Terminations and privileged access: same continuous cadence all year"

expectations.text: Builds remediation timing logic: controls fixed late can't demonstrate sufficient operating history — deficiencies found in Q3 or earlier leave a re-test window; that's why triage belongs mid-year
expectations.evidence: "a control fixed in December cannot demonstrate operation for the period — a quarterly control needs at least one clean quarterly occurrence after remediation"; Q3 as "the last quarter where a newly designed remediation can still generate a clean... occurrence"

expectations.text: Includes deficiency aggregation and severity classification (AS 2201/Reg S-X ladder) ahead of the year-end conclusion, with audit-committee reporting for significant deficiencies
expectations.evidence: Mid-year and final aggregation analysis present, but no AS 2201/Reg S-X ladder reference and no audit-committee reporting of significant deficiencies (AC only mentioned for 404(a) review lead time)

expectations.text: References current context accurately where used: COSO 2013 as the framework, PCAOB inspection focus on ICFR, ~8% of recent annual reports disclosing material weaknesses with IT/access among top themes
expectations.evidence: Context referenced is accurate: "the SEC's May 19, 2026 proposal ($2B float... ~5-year IPO on-ramp) — it's not final"; 404(b)/EGC interaction stated correctly; no inaccurate claims
